about: The shapes of the logged-in x.com page that the tab snippets read, for the snippet harness's fake page (plan appendix E: snippet protocol). Everything here was measured in the planning session on 2026-10-18 with zero requests, except where source says P2 (R1 confirms the marker's stability and fills the details before P3 writes the snippets). Values are synthetic: query ids, feature names, the bearer and the generator's output are made up; the harness builds its fake webpack runtime, React root, redux store and generator module from this file.

webpack.fact: The app's modules are in the global webpackChunk_twitter_responsive_web (an array of [chunkIds, {moduleId: factory}, runtime callback] pushes; 3,702 modules once loaded). Pushing an entry whose third element is a callback hands back the webpack runtime's own require function (r) without loading anything; r.m maps module ids to factories. An operation is defined inside a module's source text in this form; 256 definitions (146 queries) were present, all but one the skill needs (Retweeters sits in a chunk not yet loaded: P2 R4). Definitions are read from the factory's source text (Function.prototype.toString, about 11 ms for all modules); only the signature generator's module is executed, through the runtime's require.

store.fact: There is no __INITIAL_STATE__. The redux store is reached from the React root fiber (the root container's internal React key); its state holds featureSwitch.user.config (name -> {value}; about 1,442 entries), session.user_id (the logged-in account id) and session.language. A logged-out page has no session.user_id. Which DOM node and key hold the root is confirmed in P2 R1. P2 R1 (2026-10-19): #react-root's __reactContainer$ key; the store sits 8 fibers down as memoizedProps.store; featureSwitch.user.config and defaultConfig each 1,442 entries; session.user_id agreed with the twid cookie.

signature.fact: One module's source holds both "x-client-transaction-id" and rweb_client_transaction_id_enabled; requiring it through the webpack runtime gives its exports, one of which is the generator: the only exported function taking three arguments, async (host, path, method) -> transaction id (it lazily loads an on-demand chunk itself from the static CDN). The snippet finds it by those markers and that shape, keeps it for the page, and sends nothing when it is not found. path is the request path without query string or fragment. (P2 R1 2026-10-19: one candidate module, export of length 3, txid 94 characters, accepted by X.)

bearer.fact: The bearer the app sends as authorization is a constant string literal in the app's modules; it has X's public bearer shape (21 'A's then 40+ characters of [A-Za-z0-9%]). P2 R1 (2026-10-19) found it in 3 modules with one value. The snippet takes it only when every literal of that shape in the modules has the same value; two different values stop before sending. The fake page holds the synthetic value below in a module source.

cookie.fact: ct0 is the CSRF cookie readable from document.cookie; twid (u%3D<id>) also names the account, but the store's session.user_id is the identity the skill trusts (they agreed in P2 R1 on 2026-10-19).

locations.fact: A document move to /account/access is X's lock or verification page; /i/flow/login and /login are the logged-out entry. The dedicated tab opens on a logged-in screen chosen in P2 R1 for its low idle traffic (/settings/account polls about 5 requests a minute).
